scope: Queued console stdin and native child prompt delivery in the local IDE Development host
baseline_behavior: Run accepted the first child answer and lost the second early answer after question output but before its actionable prompt; retained console times out waiting for completion.
behavior: Answers entered before an actionable native prompt wait in FIFO order.
Each answer targets one prompt; supplied promptId is retained.
The final piped line without a newline is accepted; managed desktop stdin closure still cancels.
UTF-8 decoding and input-read errors reach normal session cleanup.
Input limits are 64 KiB per payload line, 128 queued lines and 256 KiB queued UTF-8 data; LF/CRLF framing does not consume the line payload allowance.
Rejected or uncertain answer transmission does not replay a line or advance queued answers.
Actual Qt Run and Debug accept two child answers typed through the readonly console, complete the parent, and export the expected child file under the exact image identity.
limitations: Offscreen Qt interaction does not qualify browser noVNC X-button or wheel behavior.
This private interpreter run does not qualify a fresh Windows OS installation.
No language inventory rows are promoted; final distribution integration and full v0.5/v0.6 gates remain open.
